dedupe_keys.name: fuel consumed in power plants in the electricity sector

description: Fuel Consumed in Power Plants in the Electricity Sector is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). A Ton of Oil Equivalent ( TOE ) =10 Million K.Calorie. One Gigawatt Hour = 0.086 Thousand Ton of Oil Equivalent. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are Consumption. The portal shows 2015-10-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
